summary.text: Josh Hurlbert is a Republican state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 8 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Transportation Committee and previously worked as a senior field representative for U.S. Congressman Sam Graves.

paragraphs.text: Josh Hurlbert was born in Smithville, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree in history and geography from Park University in 2008.
Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working as a senior field representative for U.S. Congressman Sam Graves, and that he has served as president of the Smithville Rotary Club.
Hurlbert advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the Transportation Committee (chair) and the Legislative Review Committee (vice chair).
